fixed.explanation: CREATE TRIGGER accepts any timing, but only BEFORE and AFTER triggers are expanded at DML bind time, so an INSTEAD OF trigger on a base table is stored and never fires. The edit makes BindCreateTriggerInfo reject any timing other than BEFORE or AFTER, so the trigger fails at creation instead of being silently ignored. I did not see the TriggerTiming enum, so the check uses BEFORE and AFTER only and doesn't name the INSTEAD OF value.

query.intent: Trigger support: CREATE TRIGGER binding/creation accepts INSTEAD OF timing on a base table, and INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE planning never fires triggers for it. Either triggers should execute in the DML binder/planner (replacing the operation for INSTEAD OF) or CREATE TRIGGER should reject INSTEAD OF on base tables.
query.symptom: An INSTEAD OF INSERT trigger on a regular table is created without error but never fires: the insert goes into the table and the trigger body (insert into audit) does not run.
anchors: CREATE TRIGGER tr INSTEAD OF INSERT ON t

history.analysis: Binder::TryExpandTriggers expands BEFORE and AFTER triggers into the DML bind, and AddAfterTriggerCTEs handles only the AFTER ones. INSTEAD OF triggers are never expanded for a base table, so they never fire. BindCreateTriggerInfo is where CREATE TRIGGER is accepted, so it is the place to reject INSTEAD OF on a base table if that is the chosen fix. I have not opened either function body, so the exact edit is a guess.
